verdict.rationale: Claude Code is Anthropic's official CLI, and Skills are natively invoked through it via slash commands (`/skill-name`), plugin management (`/plugin marketplace add`, `/plugin install`), and auto-inferred build/run commands (`/run`, `/verify`), all documented in first-party docs and confirmed by a real hands-on install probe. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking specifically of the CLI workflow (community evidence is more about skill-triggering reliability than the CLI itself) and no evidence of CLI-specific edge cases beyond docs/probe.
